RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0%

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so the panel's gender composition provides no evidence of sex discrimination against you. In academic hiring, committee demographics typically reflect internal service rotations or institutional diversity requirements rather than bias.

The hiring choice was likely driven by non-discriminatory criteria, such as the department specifically valuing industry experience, teaching style, or curriculum fit over publication counts. 

Raising the panel's all-female makeup would be unfounded and could damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, focusing constructively on how you can strengthen your application and interview performance for future positions.
